name: argsort
algorithm: Sort each row of float scores into an index permutation, choosing CUB radix sort for larger cases and a custom bitonic kernel for small cases.

output.name: dst
output.shape: same logical rows, storing sorted indices

io_spec.notes: Ascending and descending orders are both supported.

notes: Risk reason: hybrid CUB plus custom bitonic sort with rowwise offsets. Reference oracle: ggml-cpu backend via tests/test-backend-ops. Migrated the portable bitonic-sort path (one work-group per row, local-memory index array) matching CUDA's non-CUB fallback. CUDA's CUB-based radix/segmented-sort fast path for large ncols (>1024) is not ported - tracked as residual, out of scope for the Qwen3 dense text path (used by top-k selection, not full-vocab sort).

unit_test.result_detail: test-backend-ops ARGSORT: 46/46 passed on SYCL0 (ncols<=1024, bitonic-sort work-group cap)
